name: spell-app
description: Spell's editor and its servers:  the app, spaces, the language server, the spell CLI, the page server's Spell layer, and the spell language's VS Code extension

scripts.ts: spell-types --below && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tests && tsc -p tests/app
scripts.test: vp test run && uv run --directory src/spaces/server/py pytest -q
scripts.lint: vp lint --report-unused-disable-directives --max-warnings 0 src tests scripts app && uv run --directory src/spaces/server/py ruff check . ../../../../tests/spaces/server/py/tests
scripts.lint:fix: vp lint --fix src tests scripts app && uv run --directory src/spaces/server/py ruff check --fix . ../../../../tests/spaces/server/py/tests
scripts.format: vp fmt && uv run --directory src/spaces/server/py ruff format . ../../../../tests/spaces/server/py/tests
scripts.format:check: vp fmt --check && uv run --directory src/spaces/server/py ruff format --check . ../../../../tests/spaces/server/py/tests
scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint:fix && yarn format && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
scripts.spell:test:fixtures: vp test run --project spell tests/spell/test/fixtures.test.ts tests/spell/test/typescript.test.ts tests/spell/test/python.test.ts
scripts.spell:test:fixtures:bless: vp test run --project spell tests/spell/test/fixtures.test.ts tests/spell/test/typescript.test.ts tests/spell/test/python.test.ts --update=all
scripts.start: yarn && spell server stop && cd app && spell app serve --headless
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cd app && vp build
scripts.build:runner: cd app && vp build -c vite.solid.config.ts --outDir dist-runner && vp build -c vite.runner.config.ts
scripts.build:element: cd app && vp build -c vite.solid.config.ts && vp build -c vite.element.config.ts && vp build -c vite.editor.config.ts && vp build -c vite.code.config.ts
scripts.build:page: cd app && vp build -c vite.solid.config.ts --outDir dist-page && vp build -c vite.page.config.ts
